content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-153. - Delegated powers.
content.summary:
The officers of the city hereby are authorized and directed to take all action necessary
               or appropriate to effectuate the provisions of this article.
(Code 1981, § 27-153; Ord. No. 551, § 94, 5-14-1964)
